statements.decision: Accept soil test results with independent oversight, authorize continued Phase II remediation
statements.quote: Independent oversight confirms our soil is clean — Baylight builds on a solid foundation.
statements.fullStatement: Baylight Authority Director Keisha Ramos confirmed that Phase II site remediation continues following independent verification of soil test results. 'Independent oversight confirms our soil is clean — Baylight builds on a solid foundation,' Ramos said. The Baylight Authority has mobilized remediation crews to execute soil handling protocols while workforce pipelines activate local hires.
